site.audience: creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists seeking online learning

brief.title: CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives
brief.one_liner: An online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals, from illustration and design to photography and filmmaking.
brief.goal: Drive free trial sign-ups and showcase the breadth of creative courses, expert teachers, and community features to convert visitors into paying members.

pages.objective: Serve as the primary landing page to introduce the platform, highlight course offerings, showcase expert teachers, display social proof, and drive free trial sign-ups.

interactions.trigger: User clicks on a FAQ question row
interactions.expected: The answer expands below the question; clicking again collapses it

interactions.trigger: User clicks on a category tab (e.g., Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, Marketing, Animation, etc.)
interactions.expected: The course grid updates to show courses matching the selected category

interactions.trigger: User clicks Continue with Google button in hero
interactions.expected: OAuth sign-up flow initiates or modal appears

interactions.trigger: User clicks Continue with email button in hero
interactions.expected: Email sign-up form or modal appears

interactions.trigger: User scrolls or navigates through teacher cards in the Learn from Creative Experts section
interactions.expected: Teacher cards scroll horizontally revealing additional teachers
